services.service_name: Applying for a New Business Permit
services.who_may_avail: Business owners within the territorial jurisdiction of the City.

requirements.where_to_secure: One Stop Business Center, Official Website of Dagupan City

requirements.requirement: Health Certificate (For Food Handlers and Health Care Services)
Proof of ownership if business area is owned

Proof of Business Registration:
DTI Registration for Sole Proprietor
SEC Registration and Articles of Incorporation for Partnership or Corporation
CDA Registration and Articles of Cooperation for Cooperative
requirements.where_to_secure:
Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
Cooperative Development Authority (CDA)

requirements.requirement: Other Special Requirements (Please see Table of Special Requirements)

sub_steps.action: Submits duly accomplished business application form together with documentary requirements.

agency_actions.action: Verifies and receives the application form together with the attached documentary requirements.
Composite Team inspects business establishments.
BINning personnel encodes information.
CEO verifies compliance to the National Building Code.
CHO verifies compliance with Sanitation Code.
CTO-RPT attached RPT Billing Statement.
CPDO verifies compliance with Zoning Regulations.
Assesses and consolidates fees to be paid in one billing statement.
Reviews and approves assessed taxes and fees.
Releases approved billing statement.

sub_steps.action: Presents the billing statement to the cashier.

agency_actions.action: Accepts payment and issues Official Receipt
agency_actions.fees: Please Refer to Table of Taxes, Fees and Charges

sub_steps.action: Resubmits business application form after paying.

agency_actions.action: Receives application form and verifies completeness of attached requirements.
Prints business permit.
Reviews permit.
Releases business permit and license.

services.service_name: Applying for Amendment to Existing Business Permit
services.who_may_avail: Business owners within the territorial jurisdiction of the City.

requirements.requirement: DTI Registration, SEC Registration, CDA Registration if change of business name/corporate name
requirements.where_to_secure:
Department of Trade and Industry (DTI)
Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
Cooperative Development Authority (CDA)

requirements.requirement: Certificate of Lease/Proof of ownership if transfer of location
Letter of transfer of business ownership (for transfer of ownership)
Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (for transfer of location)

sub_steps.action: Submits application form together with requirements

agency_actions.action: Accepts and verifies completeness of application. Endorses application to appropriate regulatory section.
Application for transfer of location and additional line of business is inspected by the Composite Team.
Issues necessary clearances/certifications.
Assesses additional regulatory fees and prepares order of payment. Releases order of payment.
Accepts payment and issues Official Receipt
agency_actions.fees: Please Refer to Table of Taxes, Fees and Charges

agency_actions.action: Incorporates amendment and prints the permit.
Reviews permit.
Releases the business permit.

services.who_may_avail: Business owners within the territorial jurisdiction of the City.

requirements.requirement: Duly Accomplished Application Form for Business Closure
Certification of Cessation of business from Barangay
For Corporation: Board Resolution of business closure

sub_steps.action: Fills-out application form for business closure and submits the said form together with documentary requirements.

agency_actions.action: Receives form and checks completeness of submitted requirements.
Conducts inspection.
Assesses business taxes and fees due and prepares order of payment. Releases the order of payment to the applicant.

sub_steps.action: Receives order of payment and proceeds to the cashier for payment.

agency_actions.action: Accepts payment and issues Official Receipt.
agency_actions.fees: Please Refer to Table of Taxes, Fees and Charges

sub_steps.action: Presents the Official Receipt together with the business closure form and requirements.
Receives approved application form for business closure and the certification.

agency_actions.action: Receives form and prepares retirement form for approval of the City Treasurer.
Approves application for business closure.
Prepares Certification for signature of the Office Manager.
Signs the Certification.
Releases the approved form for business closure together with the certification.

services.who_may_avail: All citizens who plan to operate a tricycle business in the City.

client_steps.action: Secures City Engineering Endorsement Form and list of documentary requirements from Tricycle Permit Counter.

agency_actions.action: Dispenses the form and reiterates the requirements and the process for tricycle permitting.

client_steps.action: Proceeds to the City Engineering Office for inspection of the motorized tricycle.

agency_actions.action: CEO personnel performs the inspection of the motorized tricycle.

client_steps.action: Presents the Form at the Miscellaneous Counter for payment of necessary fees.

agency_actions.action: Accepts payment and issues Official Receipts and Community Tax Certificate.
agency_actions.fees: Please Refer to Table of Taxes, Fees and Charges

client_steps.action: Submits the Endorsement Form together with the Documentary Requirements at Tricycle Permit Counter.

agency_actions.action:
Accepts the form and verifies the completeness of submitted requirements.
Prepares the permit.
Reviews the permit.
Approves the permit
Releases approved tricycle permits.

services.service_name: Securing Mayor’s Permit for the Following Activities or Undertakings
services.type_of_transaction: Government to Citizen, Government to Business, Government to Government
services.who_may_avail:

1. Motorcade/Parade/Procession
2. Installation/Hanging of Tarpaulins
3. Conduct of Concerts, Live Shows, Group Assembly and Rally
4. Rental of LGU-owned facility/structure (Dagupan City Astrodome, Mayor’s Pavillion, Dawel River Cruise Dock)

requirements.where_to_secure:
Public Order and Safety Office
Philippine National Police Station

agency_actions.action:

Forwards letter to the OSBC.

agency_actions.action:
Receives requirements.
Accepts payment and issues Official Receipt.
Prepares the permit.
Approves the special permit.
agency_actions.fees: Please Refer to Table of Taxes, Fees and Charges

agency_actions.action: Releases the permit.
